romain_go: LongMemEval-S via Codex with gpt-5.6 luna. GPT-4o is no longer available.
status: DESCRIPTIVE: LongMemEval-S already observed for retrieval; Luna judge differs from published GPT-4o; no top-1, official ranking or independent-confirmation claim
dataset: LongMemEval-S, all 500 questions in source order, including abstentions; no download, no selection by outcome
engine: immutable qualified 4.0.3 source 53030c2c99b09b5dc3f8467dda0a114e47477ee2 from installed-copy proof; excludes later 4.0.4 relay changes
encoding: Granite 97m revision 835ad14087e140460703cf0fae09f97d469d65c2, auto resolved MPS, native torch.bfloat16, batch32, 512 tokens; full attestation identical to copy proof
capture: question-blind dated quoted spans 1024 chars; no LLM extraction, no future observations; isolated store per question, resident encoder; same quotes for BM25, literal C4 with lexical_guard_k=3; recency disabled, supersession/dedup confined per frozen config
judge_prompts: official evaluate_qa.py get_anscheck_prompt content snapshot; exact question-type templates, _abs detector, raw yes/no output, no added rubric or JSON instruction; whitespace-only yes/no parsing, any malformed output stops without retry
primary_metric: micro accuracy across all 500 questions including abstentions, one reader and one judge result per question per arm
primary_comparison: paired C4 minus same-arm BM25 accuracy
descriptive_numerical_criterion: complete paired denominator AND available CI95 lower bound of paired accuracy delta strictly > 0; still descriptive regardless of result

bootstrap.unit: connected components of shared answer_session_ids plus derived *_abs and source question

secondary: accuracy and paired delta per question_type; abstention subset; no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claims; unavailable intervals remain unavailable if fewer than 30 contributing clusters
order: source order; alternate arm order per question; answer then anonymous judge, both ephemeral Codex sessions
full_context: not executed: impossible in approved bounded CLI path; Zep paper Table 2 external GPT-4o reference only (full-context 60.2%, Zep 71.2%); different models/methodology, no ranking comparison
attempt_reserve: at most 200 pre-generation quota rejections; no retries of generated, tool-using, failed or uncertain calls; each attempted CLI launch consumes the cumulative attempt budget
resume: manual --resume after batch/quota only, same sealed plan, runtime, prompts, corpus, model slugs; no loop, schedule or automatic quota replenishment; pending/blocked calls prohibit resume
accounting: durable pending-before-spawn ledger; count all attempts including rejection; recover unique valid turn.completed usage even on stopped calls; unknown usage never zero; input/output/cache reported, tokens NOT quota percentages
auth: existing ChatGPT authentication only, forced_login_method=chatgpt, no credential extraction, no API client, no API key fallback

estimates.note: pilot had Astra high judge on BEAM; new Luna high official grader and LME data unmeasured; caps are stop thresholds, not promised costs/durations; one completing call may exceed observed-token threshold; subscription quota and waiting days unknown

result_availability: incomplete denominator: progress/accounting only, no final accuracy; unavailable primary CI: criterion false with reason, no fallback to unclustered bootstrap
remote_model_limit: Codex model slug/effort and CLI binary fixed; server-side weights/sampling/temperature=0 cannot be attested or forced as in the published API protocol
